notes.title: Zeit² update improves gamepad support on PC
notes.notes:
Today we released an update of Zeit² which improves gamepad support. The update will automaticly be delivered if you already bought the game. The update is also included in a first time installation of the game.

After we got feedback from some users having problems configuring their gamepad, we fixed some issues of the configuration screen. If you encountered these problems before, please try to configure your gamepad again after the updated was downloaded.

We hope everyone can now enjoy playing Zeit² with their favorite gamepad.

Thanks your Brightside Games Team

notes.title: New Release - Zeit²
notes.notes:
Zeit² is now available on Steam!

Zeit² is a traditional side-scrolling, 2D, shoot-’em-up game that brings unprecedented elements to the game experience. Zeit²’s unique time travel feature has yet to be seen in this genre even after decades of great games.

Intuitive controls allow players to move forward and backward in time making it possible for the player to combine shots and power, and even be assisted by a shadow version of yourself. Blast away swarms of enemies, get the highest score and discover how you can assist yourself in new exciting ways by warping time at will.
